# Brightyard

> Brightyard provides year-round landscape care for residential and commercial properties in the San Fernando Valley and Ventura County, California. Text or call (747) 239-4613, or email joaquin@brightyard.la.

Service area: Calabasas, Hidden Hills, Woodland Hills, Tarzana, Encino, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Agoura Hills, Westlake Village, Thousand Oaks, Porter Ranch, Granada Hills, and the wider San Fernando Valley and Ventura County.

## Guides

- [Everyday plant care for San Fernando Valley yards](https://brightyard.la/plant-care/): Local guide to watering under LADWP rules, clay soil and mulch, pruning timing, pest management, citrus care, lawns and turf replacement rebates, heat waves and Santa Ana winds, hillside brush clearance, protected trees, and a season-by-season calendar.
- [Getting your yard ready for heavy rain](https://brightyard.la/heavy-rain-yard-prep/): Storm prep for San Fernando Valley and Ventura County yards: shutting off irrigation, clearing gutters and drains, protecting slopes, free sandbag sources, tree risk in wet soil and wind, burn-area alerts, and post-storm care for clay soil.
- [What to do if a city tree falls](https://brightyard.la/fallen-city-tree/): What to do when a city street tree falls on a car, house, or driveway in Los Angeles and nearby cities: safety and downed lines, who to call (911, 311, StreetsLA, LA County Public Works, other cities), why not to cut it yourself, documenting damage, insurance, claim deadlines, and replacement trees.
- [Weeds after the first rain](https://brightyard.la/weeds-after-rain/): Winter weed control for San Fernando Valley and Ventura County yards after the first fall rains: which weeds sprout (common groundsel, cheeseweed, annual bluegrass, Bermuda buttercup oxalis), the six-week window before they seed, pulling and shallow hoeing, mulch depths and landscape fabric, lawn weed prevention, what pre-emergent and post-emergent weed killers can and can't do, and foxtails and pets.
- [What goes in the green bin](https://brightyard.la/green-bin-yard-waste/): Yard waste rules for San Fernando Valley and Ventura County homes: what the City of Los Angeles takes in the green bin (leaves, branches, food scraps) and what to keep out (plastic bags, pet waste, compostable plastics), palm fronds, cactus, dirt and rocks, LA Sanitation's free annual brush pickup, keeping leaves out of storm drains, green cart rules in Calabasas, Thousand Oaks and unincorporated LA County, and free mulch pickup sites in the Valley.
- [Getting rid of bulky items in Los Angeles](https://brightyard.la/bulky-item-pickup/): How to get rid of furniture, mattresses, appliances, and other bulky items in the San Fernando Valley: LA Sanitation's free bulky item pickup for homes and for apartment buildings with five or more units, what it takes and won't take, S.A.F.E. Centers for paint and chemicals, free monthly drop-off days in Sun Valley and Northridge, mattress take-back and recycling, illegal dumping rules and fines, Calabasas and Thousand Oaks pickup limits, and when to hire a hauler.

- [Brightyard home](https://brightyard.la/): Services for residential and commercial properties, service area, and how to request a call.
